policy: Every self-hosted font must be registered by public path and exact repository blob identity. Family licensing and exact binary provenance are separate claims; do not mark exact provenance verified until the deployed binary is matched to a documented upstream or generation source.

fonts.notice_requirement: Preserve the applicable copyright and OFL notice when redistributing font software.
fonts.replacement_if_unresolved: Replace with a newly sourced and documented upstream build before claiming exact binary provenance.
